resources.string: Mobile money payments are reported as they arrive.
Leave this alone unless support asks you to change it.
Tick the sender names this phone should read. Remove any you do not use, and add your own below.
Version %1$s. Checking for a newer one…
Version %1$s. This is the newest version.
Downloaded. Android will ask you to confirm the install.
Version %1$s. Could not check right now; this phone keeps working either way.
Allow this app to install updates
Android needs your permission once before this app can install its own updates.
Only messages from these sender names are read. Messages from people, banks and everyone else are ignored and never leave this phone.
No activity yet. Connect this phone to see updates here.
The address must start with https://
Paste either your account key, which starts with sk_live_, or a device key of 40 letters and numbers.
Not set up yet. In your dashboard open Settings, Payment Gateway, DirectNumber. Add this phone, then paste its key into the box below.
Almost ready. Tap the button below so this app can see payment messages when they arrive.
Saved. Waiting for the first contact.
Working. Last contact: %1$s. Keep this phone on charge and online.
%1$d payment message(s) waiting to be sent. They will go as soon as the internet is back.

This app sees a text message only at the moment it arrives, and only passes on messages from the mobile money sender names listed above. It cannot open your inbox. A payment message is deleted from this app as soon as it has been delivered.
Two permissions keep your payment listener working reliably.
Only configured sender names are forwarded. Your inbox stays private.
Paste your account key, the sk_live_ one from your dashboard, and this phone registers itself. A device key from Listener devices works too. Either way the account key is not kept on this phone.
Time zone for times shown here
Only changes the times on this screen, so they read the way you do. What is sent to the payment service is the exact moment a message arrived, which carries no time zone.
No sender names yet. Add one below, exactly as your phone shows it.
%1$s is already on the list, and now ticked.
Type the sender name first, exactly as your phone shows it.
Already covered, so ticked for you: %1$s
Version %1$s is available for this phone. Updating takes a moment and your settings and any waiting messages are kept.
It is now listening for payment messages and reporting them to your dashboard. Your account key was not kept on this phone.
Your gateway answered and accepted this phone’s key.
Pairing with an account key. This phone registers itself and is given a key of its own; the account key is not kept here.
This phone is paired. It now has its own key; your account key was not kept here.
A simple record of connections and forwarding.
Keep this phone charged, online and with your receiving SIM. Funds go directly to your account.

Tick at least one sender name, or add one, so this phone knows which messages to read.
